div.div:
LEGEND & LAYERS
• Black solid (2.5 px): primary compass/passage movement (double arrowhead = two-way)
• Blue solid (2.8 px): vertical UP / DOWN shaft (distinct from compass N/S)
• Purple dashed: magic word teleport (XYZZY / >>Foof!<<) · Local markers: yellow = cross-page · orange = transient · red = death
• Optional layer [Parser Aliases / Fast Travel] (hidden by default): non-adjacent keyword shortcuts (ENTRA, DEBRI, PIT)

div.div:
LOC_AWKWARD — Awkward canyonYou are in an awkward sloping east/west canyon.
EXITS (source precedence order)
1. DEPRE → LOC_GRATE [Ch 01] [not GRATE=GRATE_CLOSED]
2. ENTRA → LOC_BELOWGRATE
3. DOWN, EAST, DEBRI → LOC_DEBRIS
4. INWAR, UPWAR, WEST → LOC_BIRDCHAMBER
5. PIT → LOC_PITTOP

div.div:
LOC_BELOWGRATE — below the grateYou are in a small chamber beneath a 3x3 steel grate to the surface.
A low crawl over cobbles leads inward to the west.
EXITS (source precedence order)
1. OUT, UPWAR → LOC_GRATE [Ch 01] [not GRATE=GRATE_CLOSED]
2. OUT ✕ msg GRATE_NOWAY
3. CRAWL, COBBL, INWAR, WEST → LOC_COBBLE
4. PIT → LOC_PITTOP
5. DEBRI → LOC_DEBRIS

div.div:
LOC_BIRDCHAMBER — in bird chamberYou are in a splendid chamber thirty feet high. The walls are frozen
rivers of orange stone. An awkward canyon and a good passage exit
from east and west sides of the chamber.
EXITS (source precedence order)
1. DEPRE → LOC_GRATE [Ch 01] [not GRATE=GRATE_CLOSED]
2. ENTRA → LOC_BELOWGRATE
3. DEBRI → LOC_DEBRIS
4. CANYO, EAST → LOC_AWKWARD
5. PASSA, PIT, WEST → LOC_PITTOP

div.div:
LOC_COBBLE — in cobble crawlYou are crawling over cobbles in a low passage. There is a dim light
at the east end of the passage.
EXITS (source precedence order)
1. OUT, SURFA, EAST → LOC_BELOWGRATE
2. INWAR, DARK, WEST, DEBRI → LOC_DEBRIS
3. PIT → LOC_PITTOP

div.div:
LOC_CRACK — [unpassable crack]The crack is far too small for you to follow. At its widest it is
barely wide enough to admit your foot.
EXITS (source precedence order)
1. (implicit) → LOC_PITTOP

div.div:
LOC_DEBRIS — in debris roomYou are in a debris room filled with stuff washed in from the surface.
A low wide passage with cobbles becomes plugged with mud and debris
here, but an awkward canyon leads upward and west. In the mud someone
has scrawled, "MAGIC WORD XYZZY".
EXITS (source precedence order)
1. DEPRE → LOC_GRATE [Ch 01] [not GRATE=GRATE_CLOSED]
2. ENTRA → LOC_BELOWGRATE
3. CRAWL, COBBL, PASSA, LOW, EAST → LOC_COBBLE
4. CANYO, INWAR, UPWAR, WEST → LOC_AWKWARD
5. XYZZY → LOC_FOOF2 [Ch 01]
6. PIT → LOC_PITTOP

div.div:
LOC_EASTBANK — on east bank of fissureYou are on the east bank of a fissure slicing clear across the hall.
The mist is quite thick here, and the fissure is too wide to jump.
EXITS (source precedence order)
1. HALL, EAST → LOC_MISTHALL
2. JUMP ✕ msg CROSS_BRIDGE [not FISSURE=UNBRIDGED]
3. FORWA → LOC_NOMAKE [Ch 11] [not FISSURE=BRIDGED]
4. OVER, ACROS, WEST, CROSS ✕ msg NO_CROSS [not FISSURE=BRIDGED]
5. OVER → LOC_WESTBANK

div.div:
LOC_MISTHALL — in Hall of MistsYou are at one end of a vast hall stretching forward out of sight to
the west. There are openings to either side. Nearby, a wide stone
staircase leads downward. The hall is filled with wisps of white mist
swaying to and fro almost as if alive. A cold wind blows up the
staircase. There is a passage at the top of a dome behind you.
EXITS (source precedence order)
1. LEFT, SOUTH → LOC_NUGGET
2. FORWA, HALL, WEST → LOC_EASTBANK
3. STAIR, DOWN, NORTH → LOC_KINGHALL [Ch 03]
4. UPWAR, PIT, STEPS, DOME, PASSA, EAST → LOC_DOME [Ch 11] [carry NUGGET]
5. UPWAR → LOC_PITTOP
6. Y2 → LOC_JUMBLE [Ch 10]

div.div:
LOC_NUGGET — in nugget-of-gold roomThis is a low room with a crude note on the wall. The note says,
"You won't get it up the steps".
EXITS (source precedence order)
1. HALL, OUT, NORTH → LOC_MISTHALL

div.div:
LOC_PITTOP — at top of small pitAt your feet is a small pit breathing traces of white mist. An east
passage ends here except for a small crack leading on.
EXITS (source precedence order)
1. DEPRE → LOC_GRATE [Ch 01] [not GRATE=GRATE_CLOSED]
2. ENTRA → LOC_BELOWGRATE
3. DEBRI → LOC_DEBRIS
4. PASSA, EAST → LOC_BIRDCHAMBER
5. DOWN, PIT, STEPS → LOC_NECKBROKE [Ch 11] [carry NUGGET]
6. DOWN → LOC_MISTHALL
7. CRACK, WEST → LOC_CRACK

div.div:
LOC_WESTBANK — on west bank of fissureYou are on the west side of the fissure in the Hall of Mists.
EXITS (source precedence order)
1. JUMP ✕ msg CROSS_BRIDGE [not FISSURE=UNBRIDGED]
2. FORWA → LOC_NOMAKE [Ch 11] [not FISSURE=BRIDGED]
3. OVER, ACROS, EAST, CROSS ✕ msg NO_CROSS [not FISSURE=BRIDGED]
4. OVER → LOC_EASTBANK
5. NORTH → LOC_PARALLEL1 [Ch 04]
6. WEST → LOC_MISTWEST [Ch 04]
